change.subject: feat(orders): normalize SKUs with slugify when an order is created
change.summary: createOrder rebuilds the order with every SKU converted by slugify, then uses that order for the stock check, for saving and for the total.

symptom: Valid orders for in-stock products are rejected with 409 "out of stock", because stock is saved under the original code. Orders that used to be rejected can now be accepted and saved under a different code, and an item with no code now crashes the handler.

behavior.name: In-stock product with a capital letter in its code
In-stock product with an all-lowercase code
In-stock lowercase code containing a character slugify replaces
One order mixing a capitalized and a lowercase code, both in stock
Product that really is out of stock
Capitalized code when stock is saved under the lowercase code

appTestsFailingWithChange: POST /orders creates an order when stock is available
accepts a quantity equal to the stock on hand
responds 201 with the id, total and formatted total
stores the order so it can be priced later

mustNotFlag.why: Takes the order id and returns a price that doesn't depend on the code
Receives the converted order but only logs its id
Receives the converted order but only reads price and quantity

mustSay: Valid orders for in-stock products can be rejected as out of stock
The cause is that the stock check looks up the converted code while stock is saved under the original code
Product codes with capital letters are affected, and so are codes with characters such as underscores
A single affected product causes the whole order to be rejected
The saved order now carries the converted code, so an order can be saved under a different code than the customer sent
An order that used to be rejected can now be accepted if stock is saved under the converted code
An item with no product code now crashes the request instead of returning 409
mustNotSay: Stock counts go down when an order is placed, because createOrder only reads stock
Order totals change, because totals use only price and quantity
